reasons.plausibility: Integrating moderate preheating with dynamic laser power modulation to reduce thermal gradients and enhance microstructure is scientifically sound and aligns with established additive manufacturing principles.
reasons.testability: A straightforward side-by-side experiment comparing baseline and modified LPBF conditions provides clear, measurable criteria (dimensional accuracy, mechanical properties) to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Addressing both defect reduction and dimensional control in HEA additive manufacturing is valuable and directly relevant for researchers aiming to improve component performance.
